entities.summary: Timothy Mellon is an American businessman, the grandson of Andrew Mellon, and an heir to the Mellon banking fortune. He is a major donor to the Republican Party. Timothy Mellon was a performers & entertainers from Pittsburgh (b. 1942-07-22, Pittsburgh). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
